description: Port of typescript-eslint's `no-unused-vars` rule (https://typescript-eslint.io/rules/no-unused-vars). Flags variables, parameters, caught errors, imports, types and type parameters that are defined but never read, where ESLint reports them (the last write from the variable's own function, else its first definition). Usedness, exports, `/* exported */` comments and report anchors come from the engine's per-variable references (`binds`, `resolves.write: "last"`); the options are filters on them. An unused `/* global */` name with no declaration is reported at the name in the first comment that declares it (M12a `eslintDirective` parse; the first three names of a comment). Options are declared in the `options` define (the rule's defaults); a variant is a config patch.
